fences.title: Bunny is the healthy-path portrait accelerator
fences.decision: Healthy browser tabs load content-addressed portrait bytes directly from Bunny; one failed real-image probe selects the canonical first-party fallback for that tab.
fences.reason: Direct Bunny delivery avoids charging every healthy portrait read to the Cloudflare Worker budget. A resolver failure on one network is the reason the fallback exists, not evidence that Bunny should be disabled globally.
fences.change_control: Retiring or replacing Bunny requires an explicit architecture migration that updates this registry, the delivery runbook, source policy, production and staging configuration, behavioral tests, and deploy guard in one reviewed change.

fences.title: Gene-card semantics are accessible equivalence, not an SEO expansion
fences.decision: Every generated Iconoplasm gene card exposes one labelled semantic text equivalent of the visible card facts while `/gene/*` remains noindex and absent from the sitemap and llms.txt.
fences.reason: People can infer relationships from the visual card, but assistive technology and DOM-reading agents need explicit labels. Making those generated detail pages indexable would instead create a low-value 20,000-page search corpus.
fences.change_control: Turning generated gene routes into indexable standalone content requires an explicit product and discovery migration that updates this registry, the semantics runbook, renderer, robots headers, sitemap and llms policy, and behavioral tests together.
